heading: Built by people who take wood seriously
paragraph1: The Wood Hive started as a small renovation crew solving one basement at a time. Over the years the work grew into three connected disciplines — structural renovation, custom wooden products, and event rental structures — all held together by the same standard of craft.
paragraph2: Today the studio is a small team of woodworkers, structural specialists, and project leads who treat every space — a home, a storefront, a wedding tent — as something worth building with intention.
